question: Under what timing considerations should one have it made when materials exist?
premises: One should have the work done.
Lunar day and similar factors must be considered.
inference: When these materials are available, one should have it made with consideration of lunar day and related factors.
uncertainties: The exact object of kārayet is implied from context.
plain_english: When these materials are available, one should have it made with due consideration of the lunar day and other such factors.
